note: Small RV park beside the owner's cypress-wood trading post on FL-71 north of Wewahitchka, near the Dead Lakes and Chipola River; the back of the park borders Stone Mill Creek. Enter by the drive next to the Trading Post, not via Lake Heights Drive (the operator warns against following Google Maps). --Claude
summary: Operator site: confirmed $30/night (full hookups) and $700 monthly; the $20 self-contained rate in the fee note and the note is no longer posted (removed). Added 50-amp/water/sewer, phone/email booking. Cleared the derived camp_store (the 'trading post' is a cypress furniture and art shop). Laundry and Wi-Fi (derived from note prose) are not mentioned by the operator; left. Note: dropped the rate, rating and amenity text. Not stated: site count, max length, season.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: the operator says 'The back of Wewa RV Park borders pristine Stone Mill Creek, for fishing and kayaking' and the booking page calls the park 'on scenic Stone Mill Creek'; the entry is 'not waterfront'.

Long-stay test: the site invites stays of 'a day, week, month, or a stay for a year' and is 'Seeking Retirees', but nightly stays are sold ('$30 Per Night All Others', 'Work Campers Welcome'); no homes or lots for sale. Looks like it passes.
